messages:
mira (PM): quick sync — i pushed a short PRD draft for Console observability (dashboards + tracing + retention). link: https://redwood.app/internal/prd/console-obsv-draft
mira (PM): TL;DR: v1 = per-route latency + error-rate dashboard, trace sampling UI (on/off + sample rate slider), retention tiers 90d / 365d. v2 = query builder, custom panels, tenant-level retention UI.
mira (PM): Need scope decision: do we ship per-tenant retention config in v1 or defer to v2? customer asks (fintech pilot) want per-tenant 365d.
dan (eng): main constraint is storage & query cost. per-tenant 365d adds ~2.3x storage for our current metrics shape. can we start with org-level toggle (on/off) and a billing flag for extended retention?
alex (design): if we defer per-tenant settings, UX should make that explicit ("org-admin can request extended retention"). I'll sketch copy for the billing flow so customers don't assume self-serve.
sam (sre): +1 on cost concerns. also need retention GC plan: background compaction, and we must avoid full-cluster scans when a tenant has 365d. recommend partitioned retention keys by tenant + shard TTL.
opsbot: deploy status: infra/proto-storage v3 rolled out to 30% of nodes (no errors).
irene (prod): fintech pilot is timeboxed. they told us extended retention is mandatory for compliance; they'd accept a manual request process in exchange for earlier rollout. that suggests org-level toggle + manual upgrade path.
dan (eng): acceptance criteria proposal (quick):
- Dashboard: per-route latency & error-rate visible in Console for all customers
- Tracing: sample-control UI available, sample-rate persisted and honored by runtime
- Retention: default 90d for all; approved manual uplift to 365d for orgs (internal approval flow)
- Data safety: GC runs without impacting p99 dashboard query latency beyond current baseline (<= +15%)
- Rollout: staged canary + feature flag with rollback path

mira (PM): edge cases to call out:
- tenant requests 365d then revokes — must not orphan data or exceed quota during revocation window
- exported CSVs spanning >90d for customers on default retention (should be blocked with clear UX)
- trace sampling at 100% for high-throughput routes -> rate limit to protect runtime

alex (design): acceptance criteria additions:
- UX copy for retention states (90d, pending 365d, active 365d)
- error states with remediation steps shown inline (billing contact / request id)

sam (sre): implementation notes:
- storage estimate macro: +2.3x for orgs on 365d; we can mitigate via gzip + downsample older data to 1-min aggregates after 30d
- queries: add pre-flight tenant filter to avoid full scans

mira (PM): launch checklist (v1):
- PRD sign-off (this thread)
- design mocks in Figma + copy (alex)
notes: mira asked for +1 or blockers by EOD Thurs; thread includes quick acceptance criteria and edge cases for scope negotiation between v1 (org-level) and v2 (per-tenant self-serve).
